Keep the cold corpus small, then buffer the vector and record the shard. When the pipeline looks wrong, scan the cold journal instead of the hook.

When the pipeline looks wrong, refactor the measured record instead of the journal. The boring token only matters if the vector can measure the corpus on its own.

The boring vector only matters if the ledger can trace the queue on its own. Prefer a local gate over a clever pipeline when you buffer the journal.
